purpose: Bounded training-only refinement of the failed first-order safeguard; no new classifier or full training
margin_definition: For each normalized protected gradient u, constrain u dot d <= -0.01 times the ordinary FedAvg displacement norm. Closest Euclidean update, at most eight active sets. Fixed engineering choice, not an optimized hyperparameter
acceptance: First scale with all three actual class CE changes < -tolerance AND changes <= 0.1 times rounded-displacement directional predictions + tolerance; predictions strictly negative; retain >=10% of FedAvg norm. Never pick by recall/F1. Reject unresolved, stationary, excessively expanded or all-failed directions; no zero-step success or FedAvg fallback
risk_protocol: Deterministic eval-mode client-local CE sums and counts over all protected TRAIN rows; pool by global class counts, not client means. Baseline plus at most four trial forwards. No raw rows needed at the server in a distributed implementation; this remains a single-machine simulation
gate: Accepted non-stalled update at all three states and improvement over harmful FedAvg for at least two states. Eligible only for a separately planned short trajectory, not full training or predictive-success claims
local_training: Unchanged historical client_seed/reset-Adam/full epoch/Flower row-weighted aggregation; same CPU2 deterministic runtime as previous diagnostic, not a CUDA continuation
prior_bridge: Exact previous source/FedAvg hashes, all8 gradient work, client work, directional predictions, before/FedAvg full training metrics; original zero-margin evidence preserved
communication: Count prospective extra per-client gradient bytes, baseline and candidate scalar replies, candidate model broadcasts. Exclude protocol overhead; not measured network traffic or privacy protection
method_reference: https://web.stanford.edu/class/ee364a/lectures/unconstrained.pdf page 12 (slide 9.10): Armijo-style backtracking adapted to three losses. No claim of convex convergence for this nonconvex network
